parsed.reason: Description A says moving a card within the same column corrupts positions because detach() compacts positions without updating card.position, leading to gaps or duplicates. Description B says move_card authorises only the destination board and never checks the card's current board, enabling unauthorized moves of cards from private boards. These are different defects (position bookkeeping vs. missing authorization check) even though both involve move_card.
